description: This file defines an interface IMedia and a template class Media within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an abstraction for media communication, including methods for opening, closing, resetting, reading, and writing data. The Media class includes an internal Handler class that manages data transfer and state changes, supporting various constructor overloads for different source configurations.

classes.name: IMedia
classes.description: Interface defining basic media operations such as remote ID retrieval, open, close, reset, read, and write.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: Template class implementing IMedia, managing media data transfer with support for various source configurations.

classes.name: Media::Handler
classes.description: Internal class inheriting from SOURCE, managing data sending, receiving, and state change notifications.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier for the media source.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the media source, preparing it for data transfer.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the media source, aborting ongoing operations if necessary.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the media source within a specified duration.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the media source within a specified duration.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying source object.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Signals the media state to be reevaluated, typically after a state change.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Extracts data from the send buffer for transmission.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Inserts received data into the receive buffer.
